Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the task and prioritized searching for "Emma Swan" as the character who pulled Excalibur from the stone in Once Upon a Time. This assumption led to multiple rounds of searches focused on Emma Swan and Jennifer Morrison, despite the fact that the task was to identify the character and actor who actually pulled Excalibur from the stone. This misstep caused unnecessary delays in identifying the correct character (King Arthur) and actor (Liam Garrigan). The error originated from the Planner's failure to verify the character who pulled the sword before directing the WebSurfer to search for Emma Swan.
